+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+from app.config import get_setting
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_delete_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    admin_token = get_setting("ADMIN_TOKEN")
+    if not admin_token or params.get("token") != admin_token:
+        return 403, {"error": "forbidden"}
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    if not users.delete_user(int(raw)):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, {"deleted": raw}
